title: Detailed maple leaf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='leafGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9a3c'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#e8472b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c0281a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='leafShade' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb85c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d43a22'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M50 92 Q49 84 50 76' stroke='#b84a1f' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- main leaf body -->
  <path d='M50 76
    L46 68 L38 70 L42 62 L30 60 L38 52 L28 44 L40 44 L36 34 L46 40 L50 30
    L54 40 L64 34 L60 44 L72 44 L62 52 L70 60 L58 62 L62 70 L54 68 Z'
    fill='url(#leafGrad)' stroke='#ffcf7a' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- inner veins, lighter for contrast -->
  <path d='M50 76 L50 36' stroke='#ffcf7a' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 64 L36 54' stroke='#ffcf7a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 64 L64 54' stroke='#ffcf7a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 54 L40 46' stroke='#ffcf7a' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 54 L60 46' stroke='#ffcf7a' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 44 L44 38' stroke='#ffcf7a' stroke-width='0.9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 44 L56 38' stroke='#ffcf7a' stroke-width='0.9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- highlight on upper lobes -->
  <path d='M42 42 Q46 38 50 42 Q54 38 58 42' stroke='#ffe0a0' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
